entities.summary: Northern Mossi, a notable figure in the history of Burkina Faso, associated with Mossi Kingdoms (1170–1896). Preceded by Kingdom of Yatenga and Mogho Naba. Their legacy influenced Mossi Raid Timbuktu 1330 and Mossi Resistance to Mali and Songhai.
